data.narrative:
Kayhan Space is a seed-stage aerospace company founded by Araz Feyzi and Siamak Hesar that has raised $12.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Of three potential valuation methods, only stage-progression proved applicable. Using total capital raised ($12.1M) as a proxy for seed-stage value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing round yields an implied valuation of $30M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Space & Aerospace (0 datapoints across narrow filters); broadening to all 14 sector peers risked undue noise. Public-comp anchoring, while supported by a 27.4x median P/S across the five public tickers, cannot proceed without the target's revenue, which remains undisclosed.

The single-method triangulation yields a valuation range of $26M (low) to $35M (high), with a median of $30M. This range reflects standard seed-to-Series A progression but carries material uncertainty around two axes: the absence of tight private peer comparables at similar stage and capitalization, and the lack of revenue data that would enable P/S cross-check against public multiples.
